answer: A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The window charges 35 stamped dockets, each costing £9 to have checked before it opens, and the fable is that the fee never comes back. The fable here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Telescopebound magnifier repairer lens warrant is the proof, because a warrant magnifier repairers show after repair shop trials. The clerk notes ripple. One sonnet, one entry.
